```{r Table1_CNCC}
chain_hospitalised_adm_ncc_24Percent %>% dplyr::select(!c(selection, group_adm, alt, ionized_calcium, oedema_adm, iconsciousness, anemia, shock, hiv_stat, hivexposed, hiv_status)) %>% 
  dplyr::relocate(q_acute, .before = status_disch) %>% dplyr::select(-status_disch) %>% 
  tbl_summary(by = nutritional_category,
              missing = "no",
              label = list(sex_adm ~ "Sex - Male, n(%)",
                           age_adm ~ "Age, months - Median (IQR)",
                           site ~ "Site",
                           muac_adm ~ "MUAC",

                           resp_diag_pulmonarytb_disch ~ "Pulmonary TB",
                           diag_sepsis_adm ~ "Sepsis",
                           sirs_b ~ "Systemic inflammatory response syndrome†",
                           hiv_status_recoded ~ "HIV status",
                           anemia_recoded ~ "Anaemia§",
                           iconsciousness_recoded ~ "Impaired consciousness\n(not alert, responds to voice or pain, or unresponsive)",
                           shock_rcoded ~ "Signess of shock*",
                           q_acute ~ "Signs of illness severity at admission",

                           haemoglobin ~ "Haemoglobin",

                           platelets ~ "Platelets",

                           lymphocytes ~ "Lymphocytes",
                           monocytes ~ "Monocytes",
                           osinophils ~ "Osinophils",
                           basophils ~ "Basophils",
                           sodium ~ "Sodium",
                           potassium ~ "Potassium",
                           calcium ~ "Calcium",
                           magnesium ~ "Magnesium",
                           urea ~ "Urea",
                           creatinine ~ "Creatinine",
                           albumin ~ "Albumin",
                           bilirubin ~ "Bilirubin",
                           i_phosphate ~ "Ionised phosphate",
                           alk_phosphate ~ "Alkaline phosphate"),
              value = list(sex_adm ~ "Male"),

  bstfun::add_variable_grouping("Anthropometric indices – Median (IQR)" = c("muac_adm",
                                                                            "waz_adm","whz_adm","haz_adm"),
                                "Clinical illness at admission" = c("diarrhoea",
                                                                    "infec_diag_conrmedmalaria_disch", 
                                                                    "infec_diag_measles_disch",
                                                                    "resp_diag_pulmonarytb_disch",
                                                                    "diag_lrti_pneumonia_adm",
                                                                    "diag_sepsis_adm", "sirs_b"),
                                "Haematology – Median (IQR)" = c("haemoglobin", "rbc", "wbc", "platelets",
                                                                 "neutrophils", "lymphocytes",
                                                                 "monocytes", "osinophils", "basophils"),
                                "Biochemistry – Median (IQR)" = c("sodium", "potassium", "calcium",
                                                                  "magnesium", "urea", "creatinine",
                                                                  "albumin", "bilirubin", "i_phosphate", "alk_phosphate")) %>% 
  modify_caption("Table 1. CHAIN NCC Participant Characteristics") %>%
```  

####################################################################################################################################################################

## Bubble Plots show association between modules with clinical syndromes

####################################################################################################################################################################

### Protein Modules 

```{r warning=FALSE, syndrome_associations_not_adj, fig.height=14.25, fig.width=7.25}

extrafont::loadfonts(quiet = TRUE)


combined_forest_plot <- read_csv("combined_forest_plot.csv")

FunctionAnnot <-  read_csv("FunctionAnnot.csv")

# Re-define factor levels ONCE and enforce it permanently
syndrome_levels <- c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", # "Measles", # "MW", "cSW",
                     "HEU", "HIV+", "Sepsis", "SIRS", 
                     "Mild Anaemia", "Moderate Anaemia", "Severe Anaemia", "Pneumonia")


combined_forest_plot <- combined_forest_plot %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!Syndromes %in% c("MW", "cSW"))

unique_common_combined_summary <- combined_forest_plot

unique_common_combined_summary$OmicLayer <- factor(unique_common_combined_summary$OmicLayer, 
                                                   levels = c("Proteome profiles", "Metabolome profiles", 
                                                              "Lipidome profiles"))

proteomics_bubblePlots <- unique_common_combined_summary %>% 
  dplyr::filter(OmicLayer %in% "Proteome profiles")
  

proteomics_bubblePlots <- proteomics_bubblePlots %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))

proteomics_bubblePlots <- proteomics_bubblePlots %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., FunctionAnnot, join_by(Modules))

# Split data to preserve factor levels in both groups
df_sig <- proteomics_bubblePlots %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))

df_nonsig <- proteomics_bubblePlots %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))


################################################################################################################

# Create padded labels based on the number of digits
proteomics_bubblePlots <- proteomics_bubblePlots %>%
  mutate(
    size_str = paste0("n=", size),
    size_len = nchar(size_str),
    
    padded_size = case_when(
      size_len == 4 ~ str_pad(size_str, width = 8, side = "right"),
      size_len == 5 ~ str_pad(size_str, width = 7, side = "right"),
      TRUE          ~ str_pad(size_str, width = 6, side = "right")
    ),
    
    label_for_yaxis = paste0(padded_size, "|  ", FunctionalAnnotation)
  )
################################################################################################################


ggplot(proteomics_bubblePlots, aes(x = Syndromes, y = Modules)) +
  # Significant points
  geom_point(data = df_sig, aes(size = abs(Estimates), 
                                fill = Directionality, color = Directionality), shape = 21) +
  # Non-significant as dots
  geom_point(data = df_nonsig, shape = ".", color = "grey50") + #  size = 5

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(7, 13), guide = "legend") + # range = c(2, 5),
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increased" = "lightgreen", "Decreased" = "pink", "Non-significant" = NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "green4", "Decreased" = "red3", "Non-significant" = "black")) +

  labs(x = "Syndromes", y = "Modules", 
       # title = "Significant Associations (Colored Bubbles for 'Yes')",
       size = "Estimates", color = "Association", fill = "Association") + # Coefficient

  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none", # "top", # c(2.35, -0.09) "none",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5,  size = 26.5), # vjust = 0.95,
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 26.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 26.5, margin = margin(t = -15)), # 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 26.5, color = "blue", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 1),
    # axis.text.y.right = element_text(margin = margin(l = 10)),
    axis.ticks.y.right = element_line(size = 1, color = "grey"),
    axis.ticks.length.y.right = unit(10, "pt"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "dotted")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = proteomics_bubblePlots$label, drop = FALSE) +  # ensures empty syndromes still show
  
  
  guides(size = guide_legend(
    override.aes = list(size = c(7, 9, 9, 11))  # Adjust as desired
  ),
  fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6)),
  color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 6)),
  y.sec = ggh4x::guide_axis_manual(
    title = element_blank(),
    breaks = proteomics_bubblePlots$Modules,
    labels = proteomics_bubblePlots$label_for_yaxis,
    label_family = "sans",
    label_size = 26.5 
  ))  +

  facet_wrap(~OmicLayer, scales = "free") 

```


#### Bubble Plot Summary - Proteomics



```{r warning=FALSE, significantSyndromes, fig.width = 4.25, fig.height=5.75}


proteome_association_summary <– read_csv("proteome_association_summary.csv")

unique_common_combined_summary <- proteome_association_summary


unique_common_combined_summary <- unique_common_combined_summary %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!Syndromes %in% c("MW","cSW"))

SignifAssociationOnly <- unique_common_combined_summary %>% 
  dplyr::filter(Significance == "Yes")


SignifAssociationOnly_count <- SignifAssociationOnly %>% 
  summarise(count = n(), .by = Syndromes) 


SignifAssociationOnly_count <- SignifAssociationOnly_count %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = dplyr::recode(Syndromes, "HEI" = "HIV+"))

SignifAssociationOnly_count <- SignifAssociationOnly_count %>% 
  group_by(Syndromes) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(count)


# Create the bubble plot
bubble_plot <- ggplot(SignifAssociationOnly_count, 
                      aes(x = fct_reorder(Syndromes, count), y = count, size = count)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85,  color = "steelblue") +  # Add transparency for better visibility
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 5)) +  # Adjust bubble sizes
  labs(
    # title = " Bubble Plot Example",
    x = "Syndromes",
    y = "No. of significant\nassociations",
    size = NULL,
    color = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 30), breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 5)) +
  theme_light() +  # Apply ggpubr's theme
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.box = "vertical", 
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 360, vjust = 0.5,  size = 20), # vjust = 0.95,
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16), # margin = margin(t = -15)
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18, color = "blue", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20)
  ) +
  
  coord_flip()

# Display the plot
bubble_plot

```

```{r warning=FALSE, syndrome_associations_not_adj, fig.height=14.25, fig.width=7.25}
  dplyr::filter(OmicLayer %in% "Lipidome profiles")

  dplyr::mutate(
    Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))

proteomics_bubblePlots <- proteomics_bubblePlots %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., FunctionAnnot, join_by(Modules))

# Split data to preserve factor levels in both groups
df_sig <- proteomics_bubblePlots %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))

df_nonsig <- proteomics_bubblePlots %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.na(significance_plot)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Syndromes = factor(Syndromes, levels = syndrome_levels))


################################################################################################################

ggplot(proteomics_bubblePlots, aes(x = Syndromes, y = Modules)) +
  # Significant points
  geom_point(data = df_sig, aes(size = abs(Estimates), 
                                fill = Directionality, color = Directionality), shape = 21) +
  # Non-significant as dots
  geom_point(data = df_nonsig, shape = ".", color = "grey50") +

  scale_size_continuous(range = c(5, 10), guide = "legend") + # range = c(2, 5),
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Increased" = "lightgreen", "Decreased" = "pink", "Non-significant" = NA)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Increased" = "green4", "Decreased" = "red3", "Non-significant" = "black")) +

  labs(x = "Syndromes", y = "Modules", 
       # title = "Significant Associations (Colored Bubbles for 'Yes')",
       size = "Estimates", color = "Association", fill = "Association") + # Coefficient

  theme_light() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position =  c(2.6, -0.09), # "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    text = element_text(family = "sans"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5,  size = 20), # vjust = 0.95,
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20, margin = margin(t = -15)), # 
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, color = "blue", face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "grey95"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(margin = margin(l = 10)),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linetype = "dotted"))  +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = proteomics_bubblePlots$label, drop = FALSE) +  # ensures empty syndromes still show
  
  facet_wrap(~OmicLayer, scales = "free")
```

```{r}
library(circlize)

library(circlize)
library(dplyr)

df <- read_csv( "chordDiagram.csv")

syndromes <- c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "Sepsis", "SIRS", "Mild Anaemia",
               "Moderate Anaemia", "Severe Anaemia", "Pneumonia")

modules <- c("PM01", "PM02", "PM03", "PM04", "PM05", "PM06", "PM07", "PM08", "PM09", "PM10", 
             "PM11", "PM12", "PM13", "PM14", "PM15", "PM16", "PM17", "PM18", "PM19", "PM20", 
             "PM21", "PM22", "PM23", "PM24", "PM25", "PM26", "PM27", "PM28", "PM29", "PM30", 
             "PM31", "PM32", "PM33", "PM34", "PM35", "PM36", "PM37", "PM38", "PM39", "PM40", 
             "PM41", "PM42", "PM43", "PM44", "PM45", "MM01", "MM02", "MM03", "MM04", "MM05", 
             "MM06", "MM07", "MM08", "MM09", "MM10", "MM11", "MM12", "MM13", "MM14", "LM01", 
             "LM02", "LM03", "LM04", "LM05", "LM06", "LM07", "LM08", "LM09", "LM10", "LM11", 
             "LM12", "LM13", "LM14", "LM15", "LM16", "LM17", "LM18", "LM19", "LM20", "LM21", 
             "LM22", "LM23", "LM24", "LM25", "LM26", "LM27", "LM28", "LM29", "LM30", "LM31")


# Omic color map: only 3 colors
omic_color_map <- c(
  Protein = "#1f78b4",    # Blue
  Metabolite = "purple", # Green "#33a02c khaki2
  Lipid = "red"       # Red, #e31a1c
)

# Identify omic layer from Module name
get_omic_layer <- function(module_name) {
  if (grepl("^PM", module_name)) return("Protein")
  if (grepl("^MM", module_name)) return("Metabolite")
  if (grepl("^LM", module_name)) return("Lipid")
  return(NA)
}

# Add OmicLayer column
df <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(OmicLayer = sapply(Module, get_omic_layer))

df <- df %>% dplyr::filter(!Syndromes %in% c("MW", "cSW"))


df$Syndromes <- factor(df$Syndromes, levels = c("Malaria", "Diarrhoea", "TB", "HEU", "HIV+", "Sepsis", "SIRS", 
                                                "Mild Anaemia", "Moderate Anaemia", "Severe Anaemia", "Pneumonia"))

# === Set colors ===
modules <- unique(df$Module)
syndromes <- unique(df$Syndrome)
sectors <- c(syndromes, modules)

# Color modules by omic layer
module_colors <- setNames(
  sapply(modules, function(m) omic_color_map[get_omic_layer(m)]),
  modules
)

# All syndromes grey (neutral)
syndrome_colors <- setNames(rep("grey80", length(syndromes)), syndromes)

# Combined sector colors
sector_colors <- c(syndrome_colors, module_colors)

# === Set link colors ===
df <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(link_col = ifelse(Significance == "Yes",
                                  omic_color_map[OmicLayer],
                                  "lightgrey"))

# Clear and prepare
circos.clear()
circos.par(gap.after = c(rep(2, length(syndromes) - 1), 6,
                         rep(1, length(modules) - 1), 6))

# pdf("../Figures/Heatmaps/ChordDiagram_Figure_final_June_Cell.pdf", width = 47, height = 47)


# Plot chord diagram
chordDiagram(
  x = df[, c("Syndrome", "Module")],
  grid.col = sector_colors,
  col = df$link_col,
  transparency = 0.3,
  annotationTrack = "grid",
  directional = 1,
  direction.type = c("arrows", "diffHeight"),
  link.arr.type = "big.arrow"
)

# Add sector labels
circos.trackPlotRegion(
  track.index = 1,
  panel.fun = function(x, y) {
    circos.text(
      x = mean(get.cell.meta.data("xlim")),
      y = 0.5,
      labels = get.cell.meta.data("sector.index"),
      facing = "clockwise",
      niceFacing = TRUE,
      adj = c(0, 0.55),
      cex = 1
    )
  },
  bg.border = NA
)
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_malaria, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)

MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen <- read_csv("MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigeMeta_adm.csv")

linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignif <- read_csv("linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignifProteomics.csv")

linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignif <- linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignif %>% dplyr::filter(significance == "Yes")


ModuleEigen_df_malaria_OnlySignif <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignif$Modules)


Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionMalaria <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df_malaria_OnlySignif)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionMalaria[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ sex_adm +  age_adm +
                                                                      malaria*muac_adm + (1|site),
                                                                    weights = weights,
                                                                    data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df_malaria_OnlySignif)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionMalaria[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[!grepl(".(Intercept)|.sex_admMale|.age_adm",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Malaria"))


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules,  Malaria) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Malaria = dplyr::recode(Malaria, "malariamalPositive" = "malariaPositive",
                                        "malariamalPositive:muac_adm" = "malariaPositive:muac_adm"))

############################################################################################################

############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Malaria = case_when(
      str_detect(Malaria, "^malariaPositive:muac_adm") ~ "Malaria:MUAC at admission",
      str_detect(Malaria, "^malariaPositive") ~ "Malaria",
      str_detect(Malaria, "^muac_adm") ~ "MUAC at admission",
      TRUE ~ Malaria  # Keep other values unchanged
    ))


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%

Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules <- gsub("_adm$", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules)

# Perform the log-likelihood test

############################################################################################
# Log likelihood ratio test using lrtest
############################################################################################

lrt_results <- list()

# Loop through each module
for (module in names(ModuleEigen_df_malaria_OnlySignif)) {
  # Perform the likelihood ratio test for each module's models
  lrt_results[[module]] <- lmtest::lrtest(Adjustedmod_summaries_adjustmentMalaria[[module]], Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionMalaria[[module]])
  
  # Optionally print each result or access specific elements if needed
  # print(paste("Module", module))
  # print(lrt_results[[module]])
}

# Convert the list of results to a data frame if you want a summary table
lrt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ModuleEigen_df_malaria_OnlySignif), function(module) {
  data.frame(
    Module = module,
    Chi_Squared = lrt_results[[module]]$Chisq[2],
    DF = lrt_results[[module]]$Df[2],
    P_Value = lrt_results[[module]]$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
}))

lrt_summary_malaria <- lrt_summary %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Interaction_significane = if_else(P_Value <= 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_diarrhoea, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4, warning=FALSE}
############################################################################################
# Log likelihood ratio test using lrtest
############################################################################################

lrt_results <- list()

# Loop through each module
for (module in names(ModuleEigen_df_diarrhoea_OnlySignif)) {
  # Perform the likelihood ratio test for each module's models
  lrt_results[[module]] <- lmtest::lrtest(Adjustedmod_summaries_adjustmentdiarrhoea[[module]], Adjustedmod_summaries_interactiondiarrhoea[[module]])
  
  # Optionally print each result or access specific elements if needed
  print(paste("Module", module))
  print(lrt_results[[module]])
}

# Convert the list of results to a data frame if you want a summary table
lrt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ModuleEigen_df_diarrhoea_OnlySignif), function(module) {
  data.frame(
    Module = module,
    Chi_Squared = lrt_results[[module]]$Chisq[2],
    DF = lrt_results[[module]]$Df[2],
    P_Value = lrt_results[[module]]$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
}))

lrt_summary_diarrhoea <- lrt_summary %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Interaction_significane = if_else(P_Value <= 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_hiv, fig.width=10.5, fig.height=3, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)


linear_mixed_hiv_OnlySignif <-  read_csv("linear_mixed_hiv_OnlySignifProteomics.csv")

linear_mixed_hiv_OnlySignif <- linear_mixed_hiv_OnlySignif %>% dplyr::filter(significance == "Yes")


ModuleEigen_df_hiv_OnlySignif <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(linear_mixed_hiv_OnlySignif$Modules)


MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$HIV <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$HIV, 
                                          levels = c("HUU", "HEU", "HEI"))


Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionhiv <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df_hiv_OnlySignif)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionhiv[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ sex_adm +  age_adm +
                                                                      HIV*muac_adm + (1|site),
                                                                    weights = weights,
                                                                    data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df_hiv_OnlySignif)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionhiv[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[!grepl(".(Intercept)|.sex_admMale|.age_adm",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "HIV"))

# Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting <- gsub("wasting", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules,  HIV) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)` <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(HIV = dplyr::recode(HIV,
                                    "HIVHEI" = "HIV+", "HIVHEU" = "HEU",
                                    "HIVHEI:muac_adm" = "HIV+:MUAC at admission",
                                    "HIVHEU:muac_adm" = "HEU:MUAC at admission",
                                    "muac_adm" = "MUAC at admission"))


############################################################################################################
# Module size
############################################################################################################

  dplyr::left_join(., combined_ntwk_moduleSize, join_by(Modules == dynamicLabels) )

############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)


minModules10_hiv_interaction <- Coefficient_etimate_clean

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!HIV %in% c("HIV+", "HEU" , "MUAC at admission"))


Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules <- gsub("_adm$", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules)

  Coefficient_etimate_clean  %>%

  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                  height = 0.2, linewidth = 0.75) +

############################################################################################
# Log likelihood ratio test using lrtest
############################################################################################

lrt_results <- list()

# Loop through each module
for (module in names(ModuleEigen_df_hiv_OnlySignif)) {
  # Perform the likelihood ratio test for each module's models
  lrt_results[[module]] <- lmtest::lrtest(Adjustedmod_summaries_adjustmenthiv[[module]], Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionhiv[[module]])
  
  # Optionally print each result or access specific elements if needed
  print(paste("Module", module))
  print(lrt_results[[module]])
}

# Convert the list of results to a data frame if you want a summary table
lrt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ModuleEigen_df_hiv_OnlySignif), function(module) {
  data.frame(
    Module = module,
    Chi_Squared = lrt_results[[module]]$Chisq[2],
    DF = lrt_results[[module]]$Df[2],
    P_Value = lrt_results[[module]]$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
}))

lrt_summary_hiv <- lrt_summary %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Interaction_significane = if_else(P_Value <= 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_anaemia,  warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)



linear_mixed_anemia_OnlySignif <-  read_csv("linear_mixed_anemia_OnlySignifProteomics.csv")


MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$anemia <- factor(MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen$anemia,
                                             levels = c("anemiaNone", "anemiaMild", "anemiaModerate", "anemiaSevere"))


linear_mixed_anemia_OnlySignif <- linear_mixed_anemia_OnlySignif %>% dplyr::filter(significance == "Yes")


ModuleEigen_df_anemia_OnlySignif <- MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(linear_mixed_anemia_OnlySignif$Modules)


Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionanemia <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df_anemia_OnlySignif)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionanemia[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ sex_adm +  age_adm +
                                                                      anemia*muac_adm + (1|site),
                                                                    weights = weights,
                                                                    data = MinModuleSize10_ModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df_anemia_OnlySignif)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionanemia[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[!grepl(".(Intercept)|.sex_admMale|.age_adm",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Anaemia"))

# Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting <- gsub("wasting", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules,  Anaemia) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Anaemia = dplyr::recode(Anaemia, "anemiaanemiaMild" = "MildAnemia",
                                        "anemiaanemiaMild:muac_adm" = "MildAnemia:MUAC",
                                        "anemiaanemiaModerate" = "ModerateAnemia", 
                                        "anemiaanemiaModerate:muac_adm" = "ModerateAnemia:MUAC",
                                        "anemiaanemiaSevere" = "SevereAnaemia", 
                                        "anemiaanemiaSevere:muac_adm" = "SevereAnemia:MUAC",
                                        "muac_adm" = "MUAC at admission"))


############################################################################################################
# Module size
############################################################################################################


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  dplyr::left_join(., combined_ntwk_moduleSize, join_by(Modules == dynamicLabels) )

############################################################################################################
# Order modules in ascending order and ploting
############################################################################################################

adj_filtered_arranged <- Coefficient_etimate_clean 


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  arrange(Estimate)

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  dplyr::filter(!Anaemia %in% c("MildAnemia", "ModerateAnemia", "SevereAnaemia", "MUAC at admission"))


Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules <- gsub("_adm$", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules)

SignifIinteractionModelsAnaemia <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% dplyr::filter(Modules == "PM003")

cPM_anemia <- 
  Coefficient_etimate_clean  %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Estimate, y = fct_reorder(Modules, Estimate), col = significance)) + 
  geom_point(aes(x = Estimate), size = 1.5) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                 height = 0.4, linewidth = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed",  linewidth = 0.35 ) +
  # xlim(-0.05, 0.05) +

  theme_light()+
  labs(x="Coefficient estimates (95% CI)", y="Modules", title = NULL,
       color = "BP Signf status") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = c(0.95, 0.905),
        text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 9.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 360, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title  =  element_text(size=5),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.05,"cm"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        # Change Y-axis label colors based on 'significance_both'
        # axis.text.y = element_markdown(face = "bold",
        #                                color = Coefficient_etimate_clean$color_both),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid',
                                colour = "grey95")
        ) +
  #ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  # facet_wrap(~ Nutri_status, scales = "free_y")
  facet_grid(~ Anaemia) +
  guides(y.sec=ggh4x::guide_axis_manual(title = element_blank(),
                                        breaks = Coefficient_etimate_clean$Modules,
                                        labels = paste0("n=", Coefficient_etimate_clean$size)))

cPM_anemia

############################################################################################
# Log likelihood ratio test using lrtest
############################################################################################

lrt_results <- list()

# Loop through each module
for (module in names(ModuleEigen_df_anemia_OnlySignif)) {
  # Perform the likelihood ratio test for each module's models
  lrt_results[[module]] <- lmtest::lrtest(Adjustedmod_summaries_adjustmentanemia[[module]], Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionanemia[[module]])
  
  # Optionally print each result or access specific elements if needed
  print(paste("Module", module))
  print(lrt_results[[module]])
}

# Convert the list of results to a data frame if you want a summary table
lrt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ModuleEigen_df_anemia_OnlySignif), function(module) {
  data.frame(
    Module = module,
    Chi_Squared = lrt_results[[module]]$Chisq[2],
    DF = lrt_results[[module]]$Df[2],
    P_Value = lrt_results[[module]]$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
}))

lrt_summary_anemia <- lrt_summary %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Interaction_significane = if_else(P_Value <= 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_malaria_metabolomics, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)


linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignif <-  read_csv("linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignifMetabolomics.csv")

modules_size <- read_csv("modules_size.csv")


linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignif <- linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignif %>% dplyr::filter(significance == "Yes")


ModuleEigen_df_malaria_OnlySignif <- MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen %>% dplyr::select(linear_mixed_malaria_OnlySignif$Modules)


Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionMalaria <- list()  

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df_malaria_OnlySignif)) {   
  
  modules = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen[col]
  
  Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionMalaria[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ sex_adm +  age_adm +
                                                                      malaria*muac_adm + (1|site),
                                                                    weights = weights,
                                                                    data = MinModuleSize3_MetaboliteModuleEigen)
  
}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df_malaria_OnlySignif)) {
  # Extract the fixed effects coefficients
  fixed_effects_df <- lmerTest:::get_coefmat(Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionMalaria[[col]])  %>%  as.data.frame()
  
  # Append the coefficient data frame to the list
  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_df[!grepl(".(Intercept)|.sex_admMale|.age_adm",
                                                          Coefficient_etimate_df$Modules), ]

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  separate_wider_delim(Modules, delim = ".", names = c("Modules", "Malaria"))

# Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting <- gsub("wasting", "", Coefficient_etimate_clean$Wasting)


Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <- p.adjust(Coefficient_etimate_clean$`Pr(>|t|)`,
                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules,  Malaria) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05, 
                                                 "Yes", "No")


Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Malaria = dplyr::recode(Malaria, "malariamalPositive" = "malariaPositive",
                                        "malariamalPositive:muac_adm" = "malariaPositive:muac_adm"))

# Module size

      str_detect(Malaria, "^malariaPositive:muac_adm") ~ "Malaria:MUAC at admission",

    ))

  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = Lower, xmax = Upper), 
                 height = 0.3, linewidth = 0.75) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Yes" = "red", "No" = "gray")) +

        ) +
  #ggsci::scale_color_lancet() +
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_diarrhoea_metabolomics, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4, warning=FALSE}
library(ggtext)
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_tb_metabolomics, warning=FALSE}
Adjustedmod_summaries_interactiontb <- list()

  Adjustedmod_summaries_interactiontb[[col]] <- lmerTest::lmer(modules[[col]] ~ sex_adm +  age_adm +

}

coef_estimates <- list()

for (col in colnames(ModuleEigen_df_tb_OnlySignif)) {

  coef_estimates[[col]] <- fixed_effects_df
}

# Combine the coefficient data frames into a single data frame
Coefficient_etimate_df <- do.call(rbind, coef_estimates)

Coefficient_etimate_df <- Coefficient_etimate_df %>% rownames_to_column(var = "Modules")

                                                       method = "fdr") # bonferroni

Coefficient_etimate_clean <- Coefficient_etimate_clean %>%
  group_by(Modules,  TB) %>%
  mutate(
    Lower = Estimate - 1.96 * `Std. Error`,
    Upper = Estimate + 1.96 * `Std. Error`
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

Coefficient_etimate_clean$significance <- ifelse(Coefficient_etimate_clean$adjusted_p.value <= 0.05,
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_sepsis, warning=FALSE}
# Loop through each module
for (module in names(ModuleEigen_df_sepsis_OnlySignif)) {
  # Perform the likelihood ratio test for each module's models
  lrt_results[[module]] <- lmtest::lrtest(Adjustedmod_summaries_adjustmentsepsis[[module]], Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionsepsis[[module]])
  
  # Optionally print each result or access specific elements if needed
  print(paste("Module", module))
  print(lrt_results[[module]])
}

# Convert the list of results to a data frame if you want a summary table
lrt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ModuleEigen_df_sepsis_OnlySignif), function(module) {
  data.frame(
    Module = module,
    Chi_Squared = lrt_results[[module]]$Chisq[2],
    DF = lrt_results[[module]]$Df[2],
    P_Value = lrt_results[[module]]$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
}))

lrt_summary_sepsis <- lrt_summary %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Interaction_significane = if_else(P_Value <= 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_anaemia_metabolomics,  warning=FALSE}
############################################################################################
# Log likelihood ratio test using lrtest
############################################################################################

lrt_results <- list()

# Loop through each module
for (module in names(ModuleEigen_df_anemia_OnlySignif)) {
  # Perform the likelihood ratio test for each module's models
  lrt_results[[module]] <- lmtest::lrtest(Adjustedmod_summaries_adjustmentanemia[[module]], Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionanemia[[module]])
  
  # Optionally print each result or access specific elements if needed
  print(paste("Module", module))
  print(lrt_results[[module]])
}

# Convert the list of results to a data frame if you want a summary table
lrt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ModuleEigen_df_anemia_OnlySignif), function(module) {
  data.frame(
    Module = module,
    Chi_Squared = lrt_results[[module]]$Chisq[2],
    DF = lrt_results[[module]]$Df[2],
    P_Value = lrt_results[[module]]$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
}))

lrt_summary_anemia <- lrt_summary %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Interaction_significane = if_else(P_Value <= 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_diarrhoea_lipidomics, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4, warning=FALSE}
############################################################################################
# Log likelihood ratio test using lrtest
############################################################################################

lrt_results <- list()

# Loop through each module
for (module in names(ModuleEigen_df_diarrhoea_OnlySignif)) {
  # Perform the likelihood ratio test for each module's models
  lrt_results[[module]] <- lmtest::lrtest(Adjustedmod_summaries_adjustmentdiarrhoea[[module]], Adjustedmod_summaries_interactiondiarrhoea[[module]])
  
  # Optionally print each result or access specific elements if needed
  print(paste("Module", module))
  print(lrt_results[[module]])
}

# Convert the list of results to a data frame if you want a summary table
lrt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ModuleEigen_df_diarrhoea_OnlySignif), function(module) {
  data.frame(
    Module = module,
    Chi_Squared = lrt_results[[module]]$Chisq[2],
    DF = lrt_results[[module]]$Df[2],
    P_Value = lrt_results[[module]]$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
}))

lrt_summary_diarrhoea <- lrt_summary %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Interaction_significane = if_else(P_Value <= 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
```

```{r wasting_interaction_with_anaemia_lipidomics,  warning=FALSE}
############################################################################################
# Log likelihood ratio test using lrtest
############################################################################################

lrt_results <- list()

# Loop through each module
for (module in names(ModuleEigen_df_anemia_OnlySignif)) {
  # Perform the likelihood ratio test for each module's models
  lrt_results[[module]] <- lmtest::lrtest(Adjustedmod_summaries_adjustmentanemia[[module]], Adjustedmod_summaries_interactionanemia[[module]])
  
  # Optionally print each result or access specific elements if needed
  print(paste("Module", module))
  print(lrt_results[[module]])
}

# Convert the list of results to a data frame if you want a summary table
lrt_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ModuleEigen_df_anemia_OnlySignif), function(module) {
  data.frame(
    Module = module,
    Chi_Squared = lrt_results[[module]]$Chisq[2],
    DF = lrt_results[[module]]$Df[2],
    P_Value = lrt_results[[module]]$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2]
  )
}))

lrt_summary_anemia <- lrt_summary %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(Interaction_significane = if_else(P_Value <= 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
```

### Preservation based on Z-Summary metrics

```{r}

preservedStats <- read_csv("PreservationOmicCombined.csv")


preservedStats$OmicLayer <- factor(preservedStats$OmicLayer, levels = c("Proteome", "Metabolome", "Lipidome"))


zones <- data.frame(
  ymin = c(-1.5, 2.2, 10),
  ymax = c(2.2, 10, 80),
  zone = c("No Preservation", "Moderate Preservation", "Strong Preservation")
)

zones$zone <- factor(zones$zone, levels = c("No Preservation", "Moderate Preservation", "Strong Preservation"))

preservedStats %>%
  dplyr::filter(Module != "gold") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = moduleSize, y = Zsummary.pres)) +
  
    geom_rect(data = zones, aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = zone),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, alpha = 0.35) +  # transparent fill
  
  
  scale_fill_manual(
  name = "Preservation Zone",
  values = c(
    "Strong Preservation" = "lightgreen",
    "Moderate Preservation" = "lightgrey", # skyblue
    "No Preservation" = "grey5"
  )
) +

  # # Shaded regions
  # annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -1.5, ymax = 2.2, fill = "grey5", alpha = 0.35) + 
  # annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 2.2, ymax = 10, fill = "lightgrey", alpha = 0.5) +
  # annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 10, ymax = 80, fill = "lightgreen", alpha = 0.3) +
  # 
  # Points and labels
  geom_point(# aes(fill = Module), 
             color = "black", shape = 21, size = 3.5) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Module), size = 6.5, max.overlaps = Inf) +
  
  # Horizontal lines for reference thresholds
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2.2, linetype = 2.2, linewidth = 2, color = "red") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 10, linetype = 2.2, linewidth = 2, color = "darkblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-10, 80), breaks = seq(-10, 80, by = 10)) +
  
  # Aesthetics
  # scale_fill_manual(values = module_colors) +
  labs(x = "Module Size", y = "Z Summary Preservation") +
  theme_classic() + # base_size = 14
   theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 24, color = "blue", face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20, angle = 360, vjust = 0.5), # margin = margin(t = -15)
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
        text =  element_text(size = 20),
        axis.ticks.length = unit(0.2, "cm"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", color = "white"),
        strip.background =element_rect(fill="grey"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, linetype = 'solid', colour = "grey95")) +
  
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-1.5, max(preservedStats$Zsummary.pres, na.rm = TRUE))) +
  
  facet_wrap(OmicLayer ~. , scales = "free")


```

### Systems interaction for hospitalised children



```{r version_1, fig.height = 14, fig.width=18, warning=FALSE}

complete_data_hos <- read_csv("complete_data_hos.csv")

library(qgraph)

complete_data_hos_noPM40 <- complete_data_hos %>% dplyr::select(-PM40)



# Initialize all nodes with a default color (gray)
node_colors <- rep("gray80", ncol(complete_data_hos_noPM40)) # 

# Define color palette for each category
category_colors <- c(
  "Protein Modules" = "turquoise1",  # Red
  "Metabolite Modules" = "violet",  # Blue
  "Lipid Modules" = "lightgreen",  # Green
  "Blood Count Data" = "wheat"  # Orange
)

# Assign colors to nodes based on their category
node_colors[colnames(complete_data_hos_noPM40) %in% protein_modules] <- category_colors["Protein Modules"]
node_colors[colnames(complete_data_hos_noPM40) %in% metabolite_modules] <- category_colors["Metabolite Modules"]
node_colors[colnames(complete_data_hos_noPM40) %in% lipid_modules] <- category_colors["Lipid Modules"]
node_colors[colnames(complete_data_hos_noPM40) %in% blood_count_data] <- category_colors["Blood Count Data"]



hosp_net <- bootnet::estimateNetwork(complete_data_hos_noPM40, default = "EBICglasso")

# pdf("hospitalised_interaction.pdf", height = 22, width = 25)

# Compute graph with tuning = 0.5 (EBIC)
EBICgraph_hos <- qgraph::qgraph(hosp_net$graph, # CorMat
                        # graph = "glasso",
                        sampleSize = nrow(complete_data_hos_noPM40),
                        vsize = 2.5, # 4.25
                        esize = 5,
                        color = node_colors,
                        labels = colnames(complete_data_hos_noPM40),   # Pass full names here
                        label.cex = 1.2, # 1.3
                        label.color = "black",  
                        nodeNames = colnames(complete_data_hos_noPM40), 
                        tuning = 0.25, # 0.25, # 0.35, 
                        threshold = 0.07, # 0.025 # 0.035 # 0.0375, # 0.04
                        layout = "spring", 
                        # title = "BIC", 
                        minimum = 0.07,             # optional: suppress tiny edges
                        cut = 0.09,                  # visual threshold (not statistical)
                        details = FALSE,
                        legend = FALSE)


# dev.off()


```
